features/pm-linear-kj99.toon.body: Hands-on functional test pass with real CLI invocation and stubbed Linear GraphQL API. Found and fixed 4 real bugs (option normalization, exit codes, missing pagination, wrong deadline flag). See child Issues.

issues/pm-linear-92kd.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: The GraphQL query used `first: $limit` with NO pageInfo/endCursor and no follow loop. Linear caps `first` at 250 per page, so any sync of a team with >250 issues (or --limit > 250) silently returned at most ~250 and DROPPED the rest with no error.

ROOT CAUSE: single-page query; ISSUES_QUERY had no pageInfo block and syncLinearIssues made exactly one request.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed truncation at one page; expected all issues up to limit.

FIX: query now takes ($first, $after) and returns pageInfo{hasNextPage,endCursor}; new fetchAllLinearIssues() loops following endCursor, page size capped at LINEAR_MAX_PAGE_SIZE=250, stops at limit. Verified via stubbed 510-issue dataset: limit=510 fetched all 510 across 3 pages (250+250+10).

metadata.title: sync failures return {success:false} instead of throwing -> exit 0
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-linear-da0d.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: missing LINEAR_API_KEY, missing --team, and Linear API errors returned { success:false } from run() -> CLI exit code 0. Scripts chaining on exit status proceed as if sync succeeded.

REPRO: unset LINEAR_API_KEY; pm linear sync --team ENG >/dev/null 2>&1; echo $? -> 0 (before).

FIX: missing --team and the catch block now `throw`. Verified after fix: no-key=1, no-team=1.

metadata.title: dry-run/limit flags read kebab keys; --dry-run silently writes
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-linear-g30q.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: `pm linear sync --team ENG --dry-run` does NOT preview — it runs the write path. --limit was also ignored (always 100).

ROOT CAUSE: pm CLI normalizes loose extension flags to camelCase; code read ctx.options['dry-run']/['limit'] (kebab) -> always undefined -> dryRun=false. Proven: probe showed ctx.options['dry-run']=undefined, ['dryRun']=true.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed silent writes during preview; expected no writes.

FIX: added readStringOption/readNumberOption/readBooleanOption (check both kebab+camel); applied to team/state/limit/dry-run in command and importer. Verified: dry-run probe made 0 pm create calls, returned dryRun:true.

metadata.title: issues with dueDate use --due-date which pm create rejects (exit 2)
metadata.author: codex

issues/pm-linear-hyc6.toon.body:
SYMPTOM: `pm create` has no --due-date flag (the flag is --deadline). For every Linear issue with a dueDate, the spawned create exited with code 2 (Unknown option --due-date) and the item was NOT created — yet the code still incremented `synced`, so the summary over-reported success.

REPRO: spawnSync pm create ... --due-date 2026-06-01 -> status 2, 'Error: Unknown option --due-date'.

OBSERVED vs EXPECTED: observed silent drop of dated issues + inflated synced count; expected items created with deadline set.

FIX: changed --due-date to --deadline; on spawn failure now increments skipped and `continue`s instead of counting as synced. Verified via real pm create: item ENG-777 stored deadline:2026-07-01 with priority/body/tags also correct.

metadata.title: Add publish retry + provenance fallback to release workflow
metadata.description: Replace the npm publish step in .github/workflows/release.yml with a resilient version that (1) skips if the version is already published, (2) retries up to 3 times with 30s sleep, and (3) falls back to publishing without --provenance after persistent registry 404s. Permanent fix for the 2026-05-27 npm E404 outage that left all 19 packages tagged in git but unpublished on npm.
